evidence.reason: The preview branch guards only the top-level --output path: line 867 checks it is outside a Git checkout and lines 868-869 check it is outside the deploy root. Immediately afterward the code writes into `args.output / 'systemd'` (render_units) and `args.output / 'launchd'` (render_plists). Those child paths are never resolved/validated, so if either already exists as a symlink to a directory inside the deployment checkout, the renderers follow it and write unit/plist artifacts into the checkout, defeating the explicit 'preview output must be outside checkout' invariant and the no-writes-on-the-old-checkout rule. This is a correctness/security repair of the existing guard, not a new requirement: resolve and apply the same outside-git and outside-root checks to both child directories before writing. The fix is small and compatible (validate `args.output/'systemd'` and `args.output/'launchd'` at the same point, or reject equivalent destinations).
